steps: The sensor occupancy and existing event-audio starter options show exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one sensor binding and two explicit String parameters, retains every existing binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Cancel discards the first binding review. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.
Reopening the saved behavior restores the same sensor UUID, script identity and both literal event names. An unchanged review grants no Apply ticket and closing writes nothing.
Reopening restores the sensor UUID and both literal String parameters. Unchanged review cannot apply. No other author script, scene or physics declaration changes.

script-zh-CN.label: Godot / 触发区占用
script-zh-CN.description: 绑定到物理触发区实例。首个有效物理体进入时发布 occupied_event（默认 physics.occupied），最后一个离开或被移除时发布 vacant_event（默认 physics.vacant）；载荷为触发区自身实例编号。事件名留空禁用对应方向，双非空不能同名。按实际物理体对象去重，初始重叠也会纳入，同批变动合并为最终占用状态，不逐帧发布；关闭时清理且不补发离开。

script-en.label: Godot / Sensor occupancy
script-en.description: Bind to a physics sensor instance. Publish occupied_event (physics.occupied by default) when the first eligible physics body enters and vacant_event (physics.vacant by default) when the last body leaves or is removed; both carry the sensor's own instance ID. Leave an event name blank to disable that direction; two nonempty names must differ. Track actual body objects, include initial overlaps, and coalesce each delivery batch to its final occupied state. No per-frame publications; closing disconnects without a synthetic exit.

script-ja.label: Godot / トリガーの占有状態
script-ja.description: 物理トリガーのインスタンスにバインドします。最初の対象物理ボディが入ると occupied_event（既定 physics.occupied）、最後のボディが出るか削除されると vacant_event（既定 physics.vacant）を発行し、トリガー自身のインスタンスIDを値にします。イベント名を空にするとその方向を無効にでき、両方指定する場合は異なる名前にします。実際のボディ単位で重複を除き、初期の重なりも含め、同じ配信バッチ内の変更を最終的な占有状態にまとめます。毎フレームは発行せず、終了時は接続を解除して退出イベントを補いません。

limitations: Real Chrome with HTTP editor and disposable author files. This smoke verifies authoring only; native occupancy behavior is not verified by this browser test.
No installed Tauri, Android, Bevy, new physical sensor declaration, automatic binding, live parameter discovery or native execution is claimed.
